run_spectral_clustering_image_segmentati: run spectral clustering on an image graph to segment connected circles into clusters
build_image_graph_from_pixels: build a pixel adjacency graph from a 2D image array using img_to_graph with a foreground mask
create_masked_image_segmentation: create a masked image segmentation by applying exp-scaled graph edge weights before clustering
test_voronoi_partition_segmentation: test spectral clustering as a Voronoi partition by scaling edge data with np.exp(-graph.data / graph.data.std())
summarize_label_image_assembly: summarize assembling a labeled image array by mapping cluster labels back to masked pixel positions
